resources.string: Use your own Deezer account instead of the shared pool
Paste the arl cookie from a signed-in deezer.com browser session
Deezer did not accept that ARL. It may be expired, or it belongs to a signed-out session.
None added. Add a self-hosted Deezer instance URL, one per line
One base URL per line. An instance answers GET /health and streams from /stream/?isrc=… or /stream/{track id}. Your own ARL is never sent to it.
On · verified instances from the Source Pool are added after yours
Off · turn on "Use pool accounts" to add the Source Pool's instances
